title: Introduction Notes: Martyrdom and Citation Spillover

blocks.text: This page is not continuous narrative; it is a citation spillover from the introduction and references. It quotes a short remembrance of Tara Singh’s martyrdom, saying his deed became famous and that he offered his head for the Guru without surrendering his Sikh resolve.

The next citations collect casualty memories and anti-imperial praise: one reports enormous losses and a survivor’s family testimony, and another says the force that ravaged Delhi and was linked to Nadir or Ahmad Shah was eventually routed by the Khalsa.

The lower lines turn back to bibliography, naming J. S. Grewal’s edited Khalsa perspectives volume, another Ibid. note, an Episode 13 citation, and a Dhillon edition reference for Episode 82. The repair identifies this as scholarly notes rather than an episode.
